quotes.stopping: **Stopping.** A cell's gate verdict is settled at its third request that fails to reach ten; the remaining seeds still run if the cell's budget allows. In a screen class both arms run all 20 seeds on every cell: a third failure settles that arm's completion verdict only and ends the sampling of neither arm (IG-P-Q32). Each task has a ceiling; a task that reaches it is reported as incomplete and never extrapolated.
quotes.budget: **Budget.** Priced after stage 1 from an enumerated manifest (commands, populations, repetitions, limits, validation, grace, concurrency). An indication, not an allocation: several times the provisional round's 2.7 h. The analysts' Projection for stage 4, with today's arm only where a gate needs it and Master identity on five seeds, is about 3.4 to 4.2 h; today's arm on the failing cells would add about 4.2 h. Stage 1 grows by the rebase and the parity passes. Phase 2's repeat of the validation on the production code is priced in phase 2's own manifest, not here.

risks.title: Small samples.
risks.text: **Small samples.** Every gain rests on two to six seeds per cell, one machine and a pre-freeze source. No completion claim or reliable tail exists yet.

risks.title: Browser against Node.
risks.text: **Browser against Node.** Every number is Node on a server CPU. The factor decides Hell 1, 10x10 and 12x12; only the calibration and the browser runs settle it.

risks.title: A per-call budget can lose completions.
risks.text: **A per-call budget can lose completions.** MP12b2's false stops are the warning; the arm counts them against the uncapped search before any budget is set.

risks.title: A screen class can come out inconclusive.
risks.text: **A screen class can come out inconclusive.** One cell short of 15 matched sets leaves its whole class without the screen, so 14x14 and 15x15b10 may ship at the no-screen times (14x14: x2.6 slower in the provisional pair). The class boundaries fixed at the freeze are the only remedy.

risks.title: A second validation is possible
risks.text: **A second validation is possible** if PM1's Hell 1 output changes P4's table after the freeze.

quotes.prefetch: **Replay prefetch.** The Generator replays every new puzzle in the background once a generation ends, and a new request terminates those workers. Browser runs name their harness and keep the prefetch in the same state in both arms. `REPLAY`'s bounds were derived from `gen-v3`; they are re-derived for `gen-v4`, whose replays are measured.
